caption: Patching the payroll system costs 4,000 hours every year; re-engineering costs 3,000 hours once, then 800 hours a year. The lines meet at 0.9375 years — the payback, about 11.25 months.

spec.title: Payback on the payroll system
spec.aria: Cumulative hours against years: keeping the old system climbs 4,000 hours a year, while re-engineering starts at 3,000 hours and climbs 800 a year, so the two lines cross at 0.9375 years.
